designDetails.silhouette: Small extremely low cave arthropod with segmented trunk, protected burrowing head, short tactile appendages and exactly eight slender locomotor limbs for this V66 identity lock.
designDetails.palette: Pale gray-ivory matte chitin, translucent cool-gray joints, mineral dirt and only sparse cold photophore pinpoints.
designDetails.surface: Organic chipped matte chitin with dusty mineral abrasion; no metal, polished armor or resin biomechanics.
designDetails.anatomy: One protected burrowing head, reduced simple eye/sensors, one mandibular mouth, eight individually readable limbs, short tactile appendages, segmented abdomen; no xenomorph lifecycle anatomy.
designDetails.orientation: strict orthographic ground-level profile facing RIGHT in all 32 poses; head and mandibles point right, no dorsal/front view

designDetails.root: Ground root follows the supporting feet at a stable baseline; body never floats. Antennae and rear abdomen remain fully inside each cell.
designDetails.background: true transparent RGBA when available, otherwise perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF; no tunnel, dust cloud, shadow or gradient
designDetails.cellBounds: exactly one vermin per cell despite swarm caste; generous equal gutter, zero crop, overlap, boundary contact or cross-cell appendage
prohibitions: facehugger, chestburster, mini-xenomorph or xenomorph lifecycle cues
boss scale, giant tentacles or metallic shell
multiple swarm subjects within one cell
changing between six and eight limbs, extra mandibles or segmentation drift
